_readme: Manual review flags for Evidence Locker items. Each row: { key | politician_id + link (+ topic), status: reviewed | needs_edit | hidden, note?, by?, date? }. The key is the item's store key, served as pipeline.key by /api/evidence-locker/items. hidden = never served or shown on a profile; reviewed = profiles show a small Reviewed note; needs_edit = still shown, flagged for an editor. The raw-ingest cron never overwrites a flagged item.
